C1536.title: Quantum Blockchain-Enhanced Consumer IoT Security Research
C1536.summary: A study published on December 9, 2024, highlights that quantum computing undermines the mathematical foundations of most current encryption, posing a significant threat to asymmetric cryptography. Blockchain faces unprecedented security risks from quantum computing.
